summary.en: The morph look: a cool slate ground, one ink shape promoted one dimension per scene, interface panels in a lighter paper, one accent handed on like a baton; Inter Tight for words, IBM Plex Mono for code.
summary.zh: morph 的样式：冷灰石板底，一块墨色形状每场升一维，界面面板用更亮的纸色，唯一的强调色像接力棒一样传递；文字用 Inter Tight，代码用 IBM Plex Mono。

fits: Developer tools, APIs and interface products whose story is one thing becoming the next: a request, a response, a spec, the generated docs.
notFor: Data stories, photographs, brand-coloured films with several accents.

intent.en: One object visibly becomes the next, so the viewer follows a product's logic as a single continuous thing.
intent.zh: 一个对象看得见地变成下一个，观众把产品的逻辑当成一件连续的东西来跟。

content.en: A chain of things each made from the last (request, response, spec, docs, a running call) and a geometric mark.
content.zh: 一串前后相生的东西（请求、响应、规格、文档、一次运行）和一个几何标志。

fits.zh: 开发者工具、API 与界面产品，故事是一样东西变成下一样：请求、响应、规格、生成的文档。

notFor.zh: 数据故事、照片、带多种强调色的品牌片。

en: The accent marks only the part changing now; two accents at once break the baton.
IBM Plex Mono is not in tools/fonts.json: samples use JetBrains Mono.
zh: 强调色只标此刻在变的部分；同时两处就断了接力。
IBM Plex Mono 不在 tools/fonts.json，小样用 JetBrains Mono。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
